headlines.title: RFK Jr. takes shortcut to make some unapproved peptides available for use
headlines.description: HHS is pausing legal action against compounding pharmacies that make certain peptides, effectively allowing them to offer the unapproved drugs immediately.

headlines.title: Study estimates 75% of NFL players who died over 15-year span had CTE
headlines.description: An estimated 75% of professional football players who died over a 15-year span had signs of chronic traumatic encephalopathy, or CTE, a study published Wednesday found. It’s the highest estimate to date.

headlines.title: MAHA fractures deepen as some RFK Jr. followers turn into harsh critics
headlines.description: A scorecard from MAHA activists suggests the Trump administration has broken most of its promises to the movement. The “burn feels especially raw,” one prominent activist said.

headlines.title: Pat Croce Shares Lessons From ‘Enjoy Yourself Now!’
headlines.description: Pat Croce, the enthusiastic former president and co-owner of the Philadelphia 76ers who once climbed the Walt Whitman Bridge to hang the team’s banner, joins TODAY talk about his new book “Enjoy Yourself Now! 66 Sacred Shifts to Instantly Awaken the Peaceful Presence Within You.”

headlines.title: Clocks Change This Weekend: What You Can Do Now to Adjust
headlines.description: This weekend, Daylight Saving Time ends and even though we “fall back” and gain an extra hour, it can still mess with our body clocks. Dr. Mike Varshavski, board certified family medicine physician, joins TODAY to share ways to keep your sleep cycle on track.

headlines.title: Health Concerns Raised for Elementary School Near Data Centers
headlines.description: An elementary school in Loudoun County, Virginia is nearly surrounded by 11 data centers and community members are concerned about the pollution that be might produced and what their kids might be breathing. NBC’s Stephanie Gosk reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Olympian Chloe Kim opens up about her ADHD diagnosis
headlines.description: Olympic snowboarder joins News NOW to talk about her recent ADHD diagnosis, saying her symptoms were “so sneaky,” adding that once she opened up to her doctor, “everything suddenly clicked.”

headlines.title: Is a water leak detector worth it? Here’s what home experts say
headlines.description: I reached out to home experts to learn more about water leak detectors and exactly how they work. Here’s how you can use them to avoid frozen pipes.

headlines.title: Do you actually need an electrolyte powder? Here Is what to know before you buy
headlines.description: Experts share the best electrolyte powders for fast hydration and recovery, from brands like Liquid IV, Body Armor and DripDrop.

headlines.title: Pocket-sized point-and-shoot cameras are having a moment — these are the best options
headlines.description: I tested nearly a dozen point-and-shoot cameras from Kodak, Fujifilm, Sony, Leica, and Ricoh to find the perfect balance of size and quality.

headlines.title: How to build the perfect charcuterie board, according to hosting experts
headlines.description: Chefs and hosting experts share the best boards you need to build a charcuterie spread and their recommendations for the best meats and cheeses to include.

headlines.title: The No. 1 Way to Protect Your Heart Health During the Fall Time Change, According to a Doctor
headlines.description: Daylight saving time ends Sunday, providing an extra hour of sleep. Doctor explains what that means for heart health and how to adjust as clocks fall back.
